fields.expected:
I currently work on the machine-learning core of an anomaly-detection and alert-prioritization system at Summer Atlantic Capital / SAC Nexus. I built and own major parts of the data and ML infrastructure there, including the repository and CI scaffold, the event-ingestion pipeline, a versioned FastAPI microservice, and the public detection API. The modeling side involves temporal sequence modeling over event streams with RNN and Transformer-style approaches, anomaly scoring, and a learning-to-rank layer, plus a retrieval-augmented explanation layer so analysts can act on what the system flags. Before that, I worked with Intelehealth on AI and data systems for rural telemedicine, building a Python resource-availability scoring pipeline across 32 villages and an evaluation framework comparing LLM-generated clinical outputs against a 4,169-case clinical standard.

Outside of work, I co-founded Open Health Intelligence and am technical lead for ClarityAtlas, an iOS app I built end to end in Swift/SwiftUI with a Supabase backend and shipped into a live Johns Hopkins pilot with 30+ users. I also built a deterministic, operator-controlled browser automation agent in TypeScript and Node using Playwright, SQLite, and Express.
